name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with: { distribution: temurin, java-version: 21 }
      - run: mvn -q package
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - run: |
          docker build -t ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.sha }} .
          docker push ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.sha }}
  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - run: echo "deploy here"

# Stage 1: build
FROM maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-21 AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY pom.xml .
RUN mvn -q dependency:go-offline
COPY src ./src
RUN mvn -q package -DskipTests

# Stage 2: runtime
FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /app/target/app.jar app.jar
USER 1001
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java","-jar","app.jar"]
k: Starts stage 1 from an image that has the JDK and Maven. AS build names the stage so it can be referenced later.

Compiles the app and creates the jar. Set <finalName>app</finalName> in pom.xml so the file is target/app.jar.
Starts stage 2 from a small runtime-only image. Maven and the JDK are not in it.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: api }
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: { app: api }
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: shop/api:1.4
        ports: [{ containerPort: 8080 }]
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet: { path: /actuator/health/readiness, port: 8080 }
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  selector: { app: api }
  ports: [{ port: 80, targetPort: 8080 }]

# prometheus.yml
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
rule_files:
  - alerts.yml
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets: ['alertmanager:9093']
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: shop-api
    metrics_path: /actuator/prometheus
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['api:8080']

# alerts.yml
groups:
  - name: shop
    rules:
      - alert: HighErrorRate
        expr: sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{status=~"5.."}[5m])) > 1
        for: 5m
k: The targets to pull from. Spring Boot exposes metrics at /actuator/prometheus.
The PromQL condition: more than 1 server-error request per second.
